component.name: GenomeForge
component.summary: Local genome browser, variant explorer, plasmid & CRISPR studio

description.p: GenomeForge is a local, native desktop application for exploring a genome. It is built for the curious and powerful enough for professional genomics work, with a switchable Beginner / Intermediate / Expert interface.

ul.li: Genome browser & variant explorer: import 23andMe/AncestryDNA, VCF, FASTA or GenBank; annotate variants against public databases (ClinVar, gnomAD, dbSNP via MyVariant.info), with quick-jumps to common health SNPs and a PubMed drill-down.
Plasmid designer: circular/linear maps, restriction mapping, ORFs, primers, and a digest/cloning preview.
CRISPR studio: guide design with a real Doench 2014 on-target model, CFD off-target scoring, edit simulation, and AAV cargo planning.
Phenotype & risk: polygenic scores from the PGS Catalog applied to your genome.

description.p: Your raw genetic data stays on your machine; only variant identifiers and genomic regions are sent to public annotation APIs. This is a research and educational tool, not medical advice.
First multiplatform release: Windows, Linux (Flatpak), and macOS.
